source.title: Call for Applicants - WRT Members (January 2020)
source.content:
The WCA Results Team (WRT) is looking for new devoted and trustworthy team members!

Do you like numbers? Are you the type of person quickly spotting typos or inconsistencies in restaurant menus that others miss? Does it drive you crazy when people lack precision with data? If yes, then you might be a very good fit for the WRT!

**The qualities that you should bring to become a WRT member include:**
- You must be very responsive and be willing to work on WRT tasks regularly.
- You should have a good sense of detail and you must be able to handle data precisely and consciously.
- Since the WRT operates on the WCA results database, you have to be a very trustworthy and reliable member of the WCA community. Ideally, you are already a WCA staff member or you have a recommendation from one.
- You should have a basic understanding of what a (relational) database is. 
- Existing experience with SQL (MySQL) and programming are beneficial, but not strictly mandatory.
<!-- break -->
**As a WRT member you will work on the following regular tasks:**
- Verifying, uploading and publishing competition results.
- Handling change requests to results or personal data.
- Supporting WCA Delegates and other WCA committees with data-related problems and requests.
- Investigating inconsistencies in the WCA database.
- Analyzing the WCA’s data to provide insights for other teams/committees.
- Cooperating with the WCA Software Team to improve WCA’s software solutions related to WRT’s work. 

On average, the membership in the WRT requires approximately 4-5 hours per week. In return, you gain a deeper insight into the structure of the WCA and the WCA database, and you will actively contribute to ensuring the integrity of the WCA's competition results. The official rights and duties of the WRT as described in the Motions of the WCA can be found [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2017.1%20-%20Results%20Team.pdf).

If you are interested in joining the WCA Results Team, please send an application to WRT leader Sébastien Auroux ([sauroux@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:sauroux@worldcubeassociation.org)). The application should at least include a comprehensive description of yourself, showing why you would be a good addition to the WRT, and your motivation and goals for becoming a WRT member.

The application deadline is **January 30th 2020 23:59 UTC**. Following that date, the applications will be reviewed and discussed among the current WRT members and a decision will be made about 2-3 weeks after.

We are looking forward to your application!

translation.title: WCA 成绩组成员招募（2020 年 1 月）
translation.content:
WCA 成绩组（WRT）正在招募认真投入、值得信赖的新成员！

你喜欢数字吗？你是否总能很快发现餐厅菜单上别人没注意到的错字或前后不一致之处？别人处理数据不够准确会不会让你难以忍受？如果是，你可能很适合 WRT！

**WRT 成员应具备以下条件：**

- 回应及时，愿意经常处理 WRT 工作。
- 注重细节，能够准确、审慎地处理数据。
- WRT 的工作涉及 WCA 成绩数据库，因此你必须是 WCA 社区中值得信赖、做事可靠的成员。已在 WCA 任职或有 WCA 工作人员推荐者更佳。
- 基本了解什么是关系型数据库。
- 有 SQL（MySQL）及编程经验更佳，但并非硬性要求。

**WRT 成员的日常工作包括：**

- 核验、上传和公布比赛成绩。
- 处理成绩或个人资料的修改请求。
- 协助 WCA 代表及其他委员会处理数据相关问题和需求。
- 调查 WCA 数据库中不一致的数据。
- 分析 WCA 数据，为其他团队和委员会提供参考。
- 与 WCA 软件组合作，改进与 WRT 工作有关的软件。

WRT 成员平均每周需投入约 4–5 小时。在此过程中，你可以更深入地了解 WCA 的组织结构和数据库，并直接参与维护 WCA 比赛成绩的准确可信。WCA 动议中规定的 WRT 正式权利与职责见[此处](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2017.1%20-%20Results%20Team.pdf)。

有意加入 WCA 成绩组者，请将申请发送给 WRT 负责人 Sébastien Auroux（[sauroux@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:sauroux@worldcubeassociation.org)）。申请至少应包括详细的个人介绍，说明自己为什么适合 WRT，以及加入团队的动机和目标。

申请截止时间为 **2020 年 1 月 30 日 23:59 UTC**。此后，现任 WRT 成员会审阅和讨论申请，并在约 2–3 周后作出决定。

期待收到你的申请！
